answer: Confidential VM attestation binds each agent to a hardware-rooted key, so peers verify a unique TEE before any transaction, making it costly to forge a second identity. Capability isolation then confines each agent to a sealed terrace of least privilege, while cross-agent quorum proofs span the trust canyon between enclaves without leaking secrets. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
